events_detected.title: US-Japan-Korea Trilateral FX Intervention — First in History
events_detected.summary: Unprecedented coordinated currency intervention. US Treasury and Japan conducted first joint FX intervention in 15 years. South Korea joined — first trilateral ever. Japan sold ~$59B to buy yen. Yen lifted from 163 to 157 vs dollar. US Treasury Secretary Bessent's note: 'Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil'. BOJ using Fed swap line for dollar lending. 30Y Treasury yield at highest since 2007.

events_detected.title: Strait of Hormuz Active Disruption — US Naval Blockade on Iran
events_detected.summary: Periodic Iranian attacks against shipping and retaliatory US strikes have severely disrupted traffic through the Strait for 5+ months as of August 2026. US naval blockade choking off Iranian oil exports — Kharg Island idle for over a week, ~50 laden tankers stranded. Iran closed strait, reopened partially with ships routed through Iranian waters. Hormuz deal negotiations ongoing via Oman mediation but not finalized.

events_detected.title: 2026 Iran War — Active Missile Strikes on Israel
events_detected.summary: Iran launched ~170 ballistic missiles at Israel. Strikes confirmed in Haifa and Tel Aviv. Civilian casualties confirmed. IRGC targeted 4 US bases in Middle East. Cease-fire teetering — Iran plotting wider war via proxies (Houthis attacking Saudi, militias in Iraq). Nuclear deal negotiations collapsed. PHEIC not related but compounds crisis.

events_detected.title: Ebola Epidemic — WHO PHEIC Declared, Outbreak Intensifying
events_detected.summary: WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, 2026. Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in DRC. 1,801+ confirmed deaths in DRC, 2 deaths in Uganda. WHO chief says outbreak 'outpacing response'. Aid workers striking over pay. First vaccine candidate entering clinical trials. Sustained transmission with continued increases.

events_detected.title: China Property Collapse — PBOC Signals Loose Monetary Policy
events_detected.summary: Chinese real estate values at 20-year lows. Up to 70M jobs at risk across 50 related industries. PBOC pledging 'appropriately loose monetary policy' and 'timely policy tool adjustment' for H2 2026. Counter-cyclical support signaled. Panda bond issuance facilitation. Evergrande wound up in Hong Kong. Structural crisis ongoing.

events_detected.title: Europe Sovereign Debt Stress Building
events_detected.summary: ECB forward curve pricing 40bps of cumulative rate hikes by end 2026. Spanish debt decoupling from Germany/France — breaking technical barriers. German growth only 0.7% in 2026. ECB kept rates unchanged at July 23 meeting but hawkish forward guidance. Sovereign debt market 'profound upheaval' per analysts.

events_detected.title: Argentina-Brazil Diplomatic Crisis Compounding Economic Stress
events_detected.summary: Brazil withdrew ambassador from Argentina. Diplomatic crisis threatening most important trade relationship. Argentina's Merval down 2.61%. Argentina facing $3B IMF payments in remainder of 2026, doubling in 2027. Peso purchasing power destroyed over past decade.

summary.overall_assessment: CRITICAL — Multiple concurrent category-5 events: trilateral FX intervention, Hormuz disruption, Iran war, Ebola PHEIC. Convergence across 10 of 12 domains. Systemic risk elevated.
